new: Bench mode: a headset left on in developer mode runs tests the cloud sends, by itself. Turn it on in the menu's Debug tab (Bench mode), on the Experiments card Headset bench, or with #dev=on&bench=on.
It opens stories, jumps to chapters, measures frames, sweeps pretend controller rays over explore mode, and sends a picture of what the left eye sees.
A test may change a headset setting for a while; your own value comes back after it, even after a reload.
A line in the headset and a bar on the page say bench mode is on and how to switch it off. It switches itself off after twelve hours.
Never in a shared room and never on the main site. Only the test place's relay takes tests, with its password.
test: On the test place, Quest 3: developer mode on, menu, Debug, Bench mode on, Enter AR, then set the headset down. The line under your gaze should say bench mode is on.
Then ask in the cloud session for a report and a picture: the picture should show what the left eye saw.
Switch bench mode off from the Debug tab, and from the page's bar: the line and the bar should go.
Join a shared room with bench mode on: it should say it is waiting, in a shared room.
untested: All of bench mode on a real headset: hours of waiting unworn, the test place's proxy and long polls, the picture's read-back on the Quest, pretend rays beside real controllers.
After a new version the page reloads and waits for someone to press Enter AR (or the adb helper, which is also untested on a device).
